run_metadata.coverage_summary: Tier 1 core government portals were swept via WebSearch across all jurisdictions: Commonwealth (AusTender), NSW (buy.nsw / NSW eTendering), VIC (Buying for Victoria / tenders.vic.gov.au), QLD (QTenders / supply.qld.gov.au), WA (Tenders WA), SA (Tenders SA), TAS (Tenders Tasmania), NT (QTOL) and ACT (Tenders ACT). Verifiable open opportunities with recognisable titles and September 2026 closing dates were captured for NSW (TfNSW Macquarie Park Precinct & Bus Interchange, School Infrastructure Roofing Trade Services Panel, HealthShare NSW Operating Theatre Part B SOA, North Coast Local Land Services Cane Toad Control), VIC (Melbourne Water WTP Grit & Screenings Plant EOI), TAS (four Education/Police/agriculture tenders), NT (three QTOL tenders) and ACT (Suburban Land Agency Molonglo land RFT), plus a QLD Brisbane City Council RFP and a WA Water Corporation advance panel notice. Tier 2 water corporations (TasWater, South East Water, Barwon Water) and universities (Charles Darwin, Deakin, Curtin) were sampled and yielded several genuinely NEW buyer sources for the seed list, though their currently-listed opportunities had already closed. Tier 3 corporate (SAP Business Network / Ariba Discovery, and major-buyer portals) was checked; as on recent runs NO publicly-advertised corporate RFx was visible without a supplier login, so Tier 3 is recorded at portal level only in discovered_sources. MAJOR LIMITATION (unchanged from recent runs): the session egress proxy blocked ALL direct WebFetch page loads (EGRESS_BLOCKED for every host tried, including www.tenders.gov.au and www.vendorpanel.com.au). Every tender below is therefore captured from web-search result titles/URLs/snippets only; deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, contacts, documents, values and some exact dates could not be confirmed against the originating notice and remain pending a detail pass in a future run where direct fetching is available.
gaps: WebFetch/egress proxy blocked ALL direct page loads this run (EGRESS_BLOCKED for every host attempted, including www.tenders.gov.au, www.vendorpanel.com.au, tenders.nsw.gov.au, tenders.vic.gov.au). No tender detail page or attached document could be opened; all fields below derive from web-search snippets only.

Because detail pages were unreachable, deliverables_summary, key_deliverables, requirements, eligibility, evaluation_criteria, documents, contacts, values and some exact publish/closing times could not be verified from the source notice and are left null/empty. Closing dates shown are as reported in search snippets and remain pending verification against the originating notice.

Commonwealth AusTender: no individual open ATM with a verifiable ATM ID surfaced in search snippets this run (a Standing Offer notice SON3921486 and a Defence 'Design Services Market Sounding - Capital Works' notice were seen as discovery signals but lacked confirmable id/dates), so no Commonwealth tender was captured to avoid fabrication. A full AusTender sweep is deferred to a run where direct fetching works.

State portals (buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders, Tenders WA, Tenders SA) return JavaScript-rendered listing pages that web search does not index at row level; only opportunities that surfaced in search snippets could be captured. A full current-tender sweep of each state is deferred to a run where direct fetching works.

Tier 3 (SAP Business Network / Ariba Discovery and major-buyer portals such as BHP, Woolworths, Coles, Qantas, Energy Queensland) checked but no publicly-advertised Australian RFx was visible without a supplier login; recorded at portal level in discovered_sources only. No corporate opportunities invented.
Invitation-only corporate/consultancy RFPs (e.g. to Accenture/KPMG/Deloitte) are out of scope and not published; none fabricated.
